info.name: E-Learning AI Backend — Complete API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection covering all 14 architecture flow charts. 169 endpoints across 20 folders. Includes WebSocket test for collaboration.

PREREQUISITES:
  1. Start Docker services: bash docker/setup.sh
  2. Set {{base_url}} = http://localhost:8000
  3. Set {{ws_url}} = ws://localhost:8000
  4. Run flows in numbered order — each flow depends on the previous one's output.

EXECUTION ORDER:
  Flow 01 → Flow 03 → Flow 04 → Flow 02 → Flow 05/06/07/08 → Flow 09 → Flow 10/11 → Flow 12/13/14

Auth: Mock auth in dev — send user_id as Bearer token or omit for auto-assignment.

item.name: ═══ PREREQUISITES — Run First ═══
item.description:
Setup steps before executing any API tests.

1. bash docker/setup.sh (starts PostgreSQL+pgvector, Redis, Redpanda, MinIO)
2. pip install -r requirements.txt
3. PYTHONPATH=. uvicorn app.main:app --reload
4. Verify: GET {{base_url}}/api/v1/health → 200 OK

item.name: ═══ FLOW 01 — AI Session Creation ═══
item.description:
Flow: AI_Session_Creation_Flow.mmd
Creates an AI authoring session scoped to a user, course, and organization.

Steps:
  1. Create Session → stores session_id in collection variable
  2. Get Session → verify session exists
  3. Delete Session → cleanup

item.name: ═══ FLOW 03 — Page List and Fetch ═══
item.description:
Flow: Page_List_and_Fetch_Flow.mmd
Retrieves course page metadata and full page content for AI agent context.

Prerequisite: FLOW 01 completed (session_id set)

item.name: ═══ FLOW 04 — Similar Course Retrieval ═══
item.description:
Flow: Similar_Course_Retrieval_Flow.mmd
Queries similar courses using 3-tier retrieval (pgvector → full-text → keyword).

Prerequisite: FLOW 01 completed (session_id set), PEND-017 (pgvector installed)

item.name: ═══ FLOW 02 — Simple Chat Edit Scenario ═══
item.description:
Flow: Simple_Chat_Edit_Scenario_Flow.mmd
Full chat → plan → propose → review → apply cycle for updating a page.

Prerequisite: FLOW 01 + FLOW 03 completed (session_id + page_id set)

body.raw: {"session_id": "{{session_id}}", "course": "{{course_id}}", "prompt": "Update the title of page {{page_id}} to 'Enhanced Learning Module'", "selected_context": {"page_id": "{{page_id}}"}}

item.name: ═══ FLOW 05/06 — Create Proposal + Apply ═══
item.description:
Flows: Create Page Proposal and Apply Flow1.0.mmd + Platform Runtime 1.1.mmd
Full create-proposal lifecycle: submit → review → apply.

Prerequisite: FLOW 01 completed (session_id set)

{"session_id": "{{session_id}}", "user_id": "{{token}}", "organization_id": "default", "course": "{{course_id}}", "operation": "create_page", "resource_type": "page", "data": {"title": "AI-Generated Introduction", "template_type": "text-content", "data": {"content": "

Welcome to AI-Enhanced Learning

This page was created by the AI proposal flow.

"}}}

item.name: ═══ FLOW 07 — Update Page Proposal ═══
item.description:
Flow: Update_Page_Proposal_and_Apply_Flow.mmd
Update an existing page through the proposal workflow.

Prerequisite: FLOW 01 + FLOW 03 completed (session_id + page_id set)

body.raw:
{"session_id": "{{session_id}}", "user_id": "{{token}}", "organization_id": "default", "course": "{{course_id}}", "operation": "update_page", "resource_type": "page", "resource_id": "{{page_id}}", "data": {"title": "Updated Learning Module Title", "template_type": "text-content", "data": {"content": "

Updated Content

This page title was updated via AI proposal.

"}}}

item.name: ═══ FLOW 08 — Delete Page Proposal + Confirm ═══
item.description:
Flow: Delete_Page_Proposal_and_Confirm_Flow.mmd
Destructive delete with confirmation token gate.

Prerequisite: FLOW 01 + FLOW 03 completed (session_id + page_id set)

NOTE: Delete is destructive — use with caution. Verify page_id is a test page.

item.name: ═══ FLOW 09 — Course Validation ═══
item.description:
Flow: Course_Validation_Flow.mmd
Validates course structure, schema, business rules, export readiness.

Prerequisite: FLOW 01 completed (session_id set)

item.name: ═══ FLOW 10/11 — File Ingestion + Full Course ═══
item.description:
Flows: File_Ingestion_Document_Import_Flow.mmd + Full_Course_From_Uploaded_File_Scenario_Flow.mmd
Upload file → extract → plan pages → generate → review → apply.

Prerequisite: FLOW 01 completed (session_id set)

NOTE: Upload a real .txt file (PDF/DOCX extraction requires pdfplumber/python-docx installed).

item.name: ═══ FLOW 12/13/14 — SCORM Export + Destructive Delete ═══
item.description:
Flows: Export flow + Destructive_Delete_Scenario_Flow.mmd
SCORM export for AI-generated course. SCORM import analysis.

Prerequisite: Course with pages must exist.

item.name: ═══ WORKFLOW ENGINE — Async Jobs ═══
item.description:
Workflow engine endpoints for long-running AI jobs (course generation, SCORM export).

Prerequisite: FLOW 01 completed (session_id set)

item.name: ═══ ADMIN & AUDIT — Observability ═══
item.description:
Admin endpoints for safety events, audit logs, and compliance summaries.

All 13 flow charts require audit logging in Phase 4/5.

Flow: Similar_Course_Retrieval_Flow.mmd — Phase 1-3

item.name: ═══ e2e TEST — Full Happy Path ═══
item.description:
End-to-end test executing all 14 flow charts in sequence.

Run this folder with Postman Collection Runner.

Execution order:
  1. Health Check
  2. Create Session
  3. List Pages → Fetch Page
  4. Query Similar Courses
  5. Send Chat Message
  6. Create Proposal → Apply
  7. Create Update Proposal → Apply
  8. Validate Course
  9. Create Delete Proposal → Confirm Delete
  10. Upload File → Get Job → Propose Breakdown → Review Plan → Generate Course
  11. Submit Workflow → Poll Status → Get Events
  12. Export SCORM
  13. Audit Logs
  14. WebSocket (manual)

Pre-requisite: Flow 01's session_id is captured automatically via test scripts.
Subsequent flows reuse the session_id from collection variables.
